fusions.name: Echoing Hoofbeat
fusions.desc: Stamps out a pulse of sound that strikes the first enemy for 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Blind Panic
fusions.desc: Rears with a piercing shriek, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 4 tiles. Each has a 40% chance to turn against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Moonless Gallop
fusions.desc: Veils you in darkness for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 25% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Feeding Flight
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
